_about: 图鉴 — the codex, the ONE picture system (Hanli 2026-09-29: 「图片作为图鉴，展示人物、生物、物品、武功、经脉、穴位等」). One entry per subject, one source for the book (read-md.js) and the game (the stage's first-appearance card, Ling's Show, 录's 图鉴): scripts/codex.js resolves and draws them. People, creatures, items and arts are LINKED — every row of people.json, creatures.json (not the foe- stand-ins), items.json and arts.json is an entry under its own id, its name, line and art read from there; an entry here with that id only adds to it: `first` {book: chapter id in book.json, scene: the game scene that introduces it}, `name`/`lines` to override, `image: null` to refuse a picture (`_image` says why; a name card stands instead), `by_hero` {male, female} for one picked by the hero's gender (阿禾). Knowledge (经脉, 穴位, 洛书, 五行 …) lives here whole: name, 2–3 lines, image, credit, source, and `marks` (scripts/marks.js). The hero has NO entry and is never drawn. The book writes [words]{注=id}: a subject's card sits after the paragraph of its first appearance (first.book), later mentions are a dotted link; a knowledge figure sits under every paragraph that names it.
_marks: The animation layer (scripts/marks.js): ratio = the image's height/width; points [{id, label, x, y}] and paths [{id, d: [[x, y]…], through: [point ids, in flow order]}], x/y in 0–1 of the image, drawn as an SVG over it.

ahe._by_hero: 阿禾 is always the hero's other gender: the girl beside a boy hero, the boy beside a girl (tools/paint-codex.py ahe-girl, ahe-boy).

zh: 一只巴掌大的银狐，一条尾巴，身后八截断尾。
自称青丘之主——别的，她想不起来了。
en: A silver fox no bigger than a palm: one tail, and eight cut stumps behind it.
She calls herself mistress of Qingqiu — the rest she cannot recall.

zh: 督脉沿脊背正中上行，小周天的气从这里往上走，要过三道关：尾闾、夹脊、玉枕。
尾闾在尾骨尖，夹脊在两肩胛之间，玉枕在后脑。
过了三关，气从头顶下来，沿任脉经上、中、下三丹田，回到丹田——这就是小周天。
en: The Du channel runs up the middle of the back; the small circuit's qi climbs it through three passes: Weilü, Jiaji, Yuzhen.
Weilü at the tip of the tailbone, Jiaji between the shoulder blades, Yuzhen at the back of the head.
Past the three, the qi comes over the crown and down the Ren channel through the upper, middle and lower dantian: the small circuit.

zh: 娘把最后一点面抖了三遍，烙了两张饼，一厚一薄。
厚的那张，后来被一只狐狸吃了——她说欠你一张。
en: Mother shook out the last of the flour three times and baked two flatbreads, one thick, one thin.
The thick one a fox ate later — and said she owed you one.

zh: 银月给的一颗黑丸子，化在水里泡一夜，洗筋伐髓。
en: A black pill from Yinyue: dissolved in water and soaked in overnight, it washes the sinews and marrow.
